rows.title: Which statements take the most time?

panels.title: Top statement time share
panels.description: Percent of execution time among exported statements in the last hour, per database. The exporter limits this set by lifetime execution time.
expr: topk by (namespace, instance, datname) (5, 100 * sum by (namespace, instance, datname, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgresql",user!="hephaestus_monitor"}[1h])) / on (namespace, instance, datname) group_left sum by (namespace, instance, datname) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgresql",user!="hephaestus_monitor"}[1h])) > 0)

panels.title: Locks held or requested, by mode
panels.description: This count includes held locks. Use pg_stat_activity to check which sessions wait.

panels.title: Dead rows by table
panels.description: The ten highest dead-row estimates. This shows vacuum pressure.

panels.title: Replica replay lag
panels.description: Shown for replicas. Idle replicas can go without replay.

panels.title: Database sizes and bundled volume capacity
panels.description: Compare the database sizes with the provisioned capacity. WAL and other files also use the volume.

panels.title: Reads that tenancy refused or reported, per day
panels.description: tenancy_violation_total, by table and enforcement mode.

panels.title: Privacy jobs, per day
panels.description: Runs by job and outcome. The store keeps the job as exported_job.
